summary: AI Technology Group Inc. (filer) disclosed amendments to its Agreement and Plan of Merger with AVM Biotechnology Inc. and Biomed 360 Solutions Corp. The merger involves convertible loans structured in tranches: Tranche 1 of $1M at $1.00/share, Tranche 2 (initial $1.125M plus future increments totaling up to $2.875M by November 2026) at $2.50/share, and Tranche 3 requiring a minimum of $50M in gross proceeds at $5.00/share or higher. The merged entity will initially be an OTCQB company, with a binding broker-dealer engagement to uplist to a senior US exchange. Closing is targeted by December 31, 2026, extendable to March 31, 2027. Risks include reliance on future financing tranches and potential delays from financial audit obligations.
